list.title: Orders
list.emptySubline: New orders appear here automatically. Older orders are added by the command “bin/console ordo:order:sync”.

info.title: Control centre: all orders at a glance
info.text: Every order automatically gets an order file; every item has its own status. “Needs action” shows orders waiting for the customer or on hold – e.g. missing artwork or open prepayment. Click the order number to open the file.

filter.actionHelp: At least one item is waiting for the customer (artwork, approval, payment, question) or is on hold.
filter.openHelp: At least one item has not been shipped or cancelled yet.
filter.finishedHelp: All items are shipped, delivered or cancelled.

detail.title: Order {number}
detail.noTransitions: No change possible in this status.
detail.noteHelp: Internal note on the order file, visible to all staff, never to the customer. Example: “Customer will call back tomorrow about the colour”.
detail.notePlaceholder: e.g. customer wants delivery from 15 Dec
detail.reasonHelp: Stored in the log and helps colleagues understand the change. Example: “Customer sent a new file by email”.
detail.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. question about film colour open
detail.errorTransition: The status could not be changed. Please reload the page and try again.
detail.errorNote: The note could not be saved.

info.title: Order file
info.text: Here you see every item with its status. Use “Change status” to move an item on, e.g. from “Artwork check” to “Released”. Only allowed steps are offered. Every change and note is logged with your name.

transition.forwardText: Move “{position}” to another station – you can also skip or go back.
transition.targetHelp: State the position moves to. Example: “Ready to ship” if finishing is not needed.
transition.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. no lamination needed, straight to shipping

workspace.title: Ordo workspace
workspace.openWindowHelp: Opens the full-screen workspace without the Shopware menu in its own window.
workspace.emptyText: No position is waiting in this area. New orders appear here automatically.
workspace.noAreaText: Your role has no Ordo area yet. Ask the administrator to assign e.g. the role “Ordo – Produktion”.

chef.title: Control centre
chef.info: All open positions of every station. The figures above show where work piles up – click one to filter, e.g. “Awaiting payment”.

service.title: Customer service
service.info: New orders, queries, payment and released items. The file shows the whole order; “Forward” sends a position to any station, e.g. back to artwork check.

artwork.title: Artwork check
artwork.info: Positions whose artwork is missing, being checked or awaiting customer approval. “Release” finishes the check; faulty files via “Forward” → “Artwork rejected” with a reason.

production.title: Production
production.info: Released positions and work in progress, oldest order first. “Start production” begins, “Ready to ship” finishes. To skip or return a station use “Forward”.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.info: Positions ready to ship. “Shipped” finishes; label and delivery note follow with the shipping workspace (roadmap step 9).

ld_ordo.label: Ordo – workspaces
ld_ordo.service: Customer service: all orders, any state
ld_ordo.purchase: Purchase price and margin (requires Mensura purchase right)
